script.es: Tu cuerpo, cuidado con manos expertas.
script.en: Your body, cared for by expert hands.

parrafo.es: En Benassi Body Care, Angelica te recibe en un espacio tranquilo en Doral para sesiones de drenaje linfático de cuerpo completo y tratamientos corporales pensados para que salgas sintiéndote ligera y cuidada.
parrafo.en: At Benassi Body Care, Angelica welcomes you into a calm space in Doral for full-body lymphatic drainage sessions and body treatments designed to leave you feeling light and cared for.

hero.imagen_alt: Treatment room at Benassi Body Care in Doral, ready for a session

parrafo_1.es: Benassi Body Care es un estudio de drenaje linfático y cuidado corporal en Doral. Angelica atiende cada sesión personalmente, sin prisas, para que entiendas el proceso y salgas notando la diferencia.
parrafo_1.en: Benassi Body Care is a lymphatic drainage and body care studio in Doral. Angelica runs every session herself, without rushing, so you understand the process and leave feeling the difference.

parrafo_2.es: Las personas que la visitan repiten por la misma razón: manos suaves, explicaciones claras y un espacio tranquilo donde la sesión se siente cuidada de principio a fin.
parrafo_2.en: The people who visit her come back for the same reason: gentle hands, clear explanations, and a calm space where every session feels taken care of from start to finish.

nosotros.imagen_1_alt: Angelica preparing the treatment table at Benassi Body Care
nosotros.imagen_2_alt: Treatment room with body care equipment at Benassi Body Care

texto.es: Nos cuentas qué buscas y agendamos tu sesión por teléfono o por Instagram. Sin formularios ni intermediarios.
texto.en: Tell us what you are looking for and we book your session by phone or Instagram. No forms, no middlemen.

texto.es: Antes de empezar, Angelica revisa contigo tu objetivo y cualquier detalle de salud relevante para adaptar la sesión.
texto.en: Before starting, Angelica goes over your goal with you and any relevant health details to tailor the session.

texto.es: La sesión combina masaje manual de drenaje linfático con el equipo que corresponda, en un ambiente tranquilo y privado.
texto.en: The session combines hands-on lymphatic drainage massage with the right equipment, in a calm, private room.

texto.es: Sales con indicaciones claras para cuidar el resultado y, si aplica, con tu próxima cita ya agendada.
texto.en: You leave with clear notes on how to care for the result and, if it applies, your next visit already booked.

nota.es: Cada sesión y paquete se cotiza según tu objetivo. Llámanos y te explicamos las opciones sin compromiso.
nota.en: Every session and package is quoted based on your goal. Call us and we will walk you through the options, no strings attached.

texto.es: El servicio insignia de Benassi. Un masaje manual pensado para estimular el sistema linfático y dejarte sintiendo el cuerpo más ligero.
texto.en: Benassi's signature service. A hands-on massage designed to stimulate the lymphatic system and leave your body feeling lighter.

texto.es: Un envolvente térmico de cuerpo completo que se combina con el drenaje para potenciar la sesión.
texto.en: A full-body thermal wrap used alongside the drainage work to round out the session.

texto.es: Equipo especializado de contorno corporal que Angelica incorpora cuando tu objetivo lo pide.
texto.en: Specialized body contouring equipment that Angelica brings into the session when your goal calls for it.

texto.es: Para quienes buscan resultados sostenidos, hay paquetes de varias sesiones con mejor precio por visita.
texto.en: For those after lasting results, multi-session packages are available at a better price per visit.

pie.es: ¿No ves lo que buscas? Llámanos igual, Angelica te cuenta qué más maneja.
pie.en: Do not see what you are after? Call anyway, Angelica will tell you what else she offers.

items.quote: Absolutely amazing experience! The full-body lymphatic drainage massage is wonderful, and the results are even better! She is extremely skilled, professional, and attentive to every detail. I highly recommend her massage package to anyone looking for excellent care and incredible results. Worth every penny!

Simply INCREDIBLE! Angelica is a spectacular massage therapist with great knowledge of different techniques. She's also very friendly and her space is extremely comfortable. The place is easy to find, and parking spaces are abundant. I highly recommend her services.

Angelica is so so so amazing! She's so sweet and makes you feel comfortable and cared for. She has such gentle hands and does an incredible job with her lymphatic massages. You can really feel the care she puts into her work.

texto.es: La vía más directa para agendar tu sesión con Angelica.
texto.en: The most direct way to book your session with Angelica.

texto.es: Mira el estudio y escríbenos por DM si prefieres.
texto.en: See the studio and message us by DM if you prefer.

texto.es: Horario: Lun a Jue y Vie, 9 AM a 8 PM. Sáb, 8 AM a 3 PM. Dom, cerrado.
texto.en: Hours: Mon to Thu and Fri, 9 AM to 8 PM. Sat, 8 AM to 3 PM. Closed Sundays.
